title: free standing vanity mirror
text: free standing vanity mirror. I wanted a vanity mirror that didn't light up - so I selected this one.  It is PERFECT.  Just the right size.  I do wish the base was a brushed chrome instead of the mirror finish - that's going to be a cleaning job... but I like the mirror enough I will just dust it daily.  They must know this as they included a tiny microfiber cloth wipe. Also the edge will need wiping for finger prints... The edge is a tiny bevel - around or less than 1/4."  You can use it upright (rectangle) or side to side.  There is a pivot on the back.  At first I was concerned because it seemed so loose.. but there is a screw (Phillips head) on the back that you can tighten the tilt - so ... good!  So far, this is one of my favorite purchases for my bathroom remodel.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
